title: Elige el mundo visual de la portada
question: The roll assigned Obra negra. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Obra negra
options.lineage: Habilitado de acero and cimbra on Mexican sites
options.thesis: Every quantity arrives tagged like habilitated steel: mark, eje, medida, hoja, tied to its element.
materials: colado aparente with cimbra panel joints and tie holes
kraft rebar tags on alambre recocido
options.viewport: Concrete panel field; headline across two panels left; right, a structural fragment (ejes, trabe T-3) in cal lines with tags wired to elements; Crear cuenta as a plate.
options.risk: Tips into construction-site costume (hazard stripes, hard hats) if the materials are rendered literally.

raised.raise: One brightest mark per viewport: only the selected quantity wears the marking colour.
The scroll runs the real stations in order, Planos → Revisión → Catálogo → Presupuesto, each closing with its lock.
Hierarchy by scale alone: measures at display size, tiny mono labels, no icon tiles or feature cards.
Lining numerals as the spine: every measure aligned on decimal tabs.
The catálogo shown as an inventory grid of real claves with their units, never a feature list.

options.label: Pie de plano
options.lineage: Plotted structural sheets with zone-marked border and cuadro de referencia
options.thesis: The homepage is one plotted sheet: zone-marked border, ejes framing the headline, and a title block where you sign up.
options.viewport: Full-bleed sheet; headline set between ejes A–B; title block bottom right holds Klave, revisión, firmas and Crear cuenta.
options.risk: The most familiar construction-tech look; the blueprint lineage is where most runs in this category land.

options.label: Swiss poster wall
options.thesis: One modular grid; each stage of the bid is a poster in the series, quantities drawn as bars.
options.viewport: Huge flush-left headline on a 12-column module; a stack of quantity bars right, one in signal blue; Crear cuenta on the grid.
options.case: Holds product clarity (objective, sharp, concise) but loses audience identification: nothing in it is Mexican obra.
options.risk: Reads as generic Swiss-styled SaaS when the grid is not strictly kept.

options.label: Luminescent understory
options.thesis: Attention lights the path; the focused growth blooms brightest.
options.viewport: Dark field, labels blooming by proximity.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no cost engineer recognises it, and glow muddies the evidence story.

options.label: Accretion disk
options.thesis: Matter crossing an irreversible threshold, ringed in lining numerals.
options.viewport: A bright disk with labels orbiting its rim.
options.case: Fuses poorly: spectacle with no tie to plans or bids.
options.kept: Lining numerals as the composition's spine.
options.risk: Sci-fi costume for a spreadsheet trade.

options.label: Darkroom safelight bay
options.thesis: Fixed stations in order, irreversible past marked points.
options.viewport: Stations under amber light, a print emerging.
options.case: The stage-and-lock idea fits Klave's node board, but the amber world means nothing to the audience.
options.kept: The scroll as ordered stations with locks.
options.risk: Nostalgic and dim for a working office.

options.label: Variable font specimen
options.thesis: Scale contrast alone carries the hierarchy.
options.viewport: One giant letter morphing under a slider.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a type toy, not a quantity story.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale alone, no ornament.
options.risk: Self-indulgent for buyers of a work tool.

options.label: Chaekgeori shelf
options.thesis: An inventory cabinet that opens toward you.
options.viewport: A grid of shelf boxes in reverse perspective.
options.case: Fuses poorly: foreign to the audience and to the product.
options.kept: Inventory as composition for the catálogo.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A SaaS landing: headline and screenshot side by side, features below, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, app screenshot right, two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other construction-software site.
